parameters.query:
SELECT CASE 
  WHEN $2::text = 'create' THEN (
    INSERT INTO public.pending_clarifications (user_id, question_text, question_type, channel, status) 
    VALUES ($1::uuid, $3, $4, 'telegram', 'pending') 
    RETURNING id::text
  )
  WHEN $2::text = 'resolve' AND $5::uuid IS NOT NULL THEN (
    SELECT public.resolve_clarification($5::uuid, $6::text)::text
  )
  ELSE NULL 
END as clar_res;
